name: fontconfig
notes: Added 2026-10-11 for Web Tranche 3B milestone B3: the bundled Skia (Source/ThirdParty/skia/CMakeLists.txt) and WebKit's Skia font backend (WebCore/platform/graphics/skia/FontCacheSkia.cpp, SkiaSystemFallbackFontCache.cpp) use fontconfig on every platform that is not Android or Windows, so the 'no fontconfig' decision D6 could not be kept without patching WebKit. The library is built and linked; the font set it sees is controlled by the embedder's FcConfig (FONTCONFIG_FILE/FONTCONFIG_PATH, or crtweb's own).

The font and cache directories point under the port prefix; --disable-cache-build keeps the build from running fc-cache with the target binary during install. gperf is the CRT gperf port (the tarball ships generated hash tables only for some objects).
macOS (2026-10-12 replay): ELF-only link flags are per-host overrides, test link lines name .dylib, and tests of shared libraries use the shared C runtime.

macOS (2026-10-12 replay): path_prepend puts the CRT gperf (3.3, size_t lengths) ahead of whatever `gperf` the host has: configure's probe of the generated lookup function's length type runs bare `gperf`, and Xcode ships 3.0.3 (unsigned int), so the prototype and the generated definition disagreed. -D__linux__=1: fcstat.c identifies a file system through struct statfs.f_type under __linux__; this libc's struct statfs is Bionic's (f_type, no f_fstypename) on every host, and the CRT wrapper leaves __APPLE__ and __linux__ undefined on macOS, so no branch matched.

Removal condition for the macOS -D__linux__=1: fontconfig's fcstat.c selects struct statfs.f_type under `__linux__` and f_fstypename under HAVE_STRUCT_STATFS_F_FSTYPENAME; this libc's struct statfs is Bionic's on every host. Drop the define when CRT's macOS struct statfs also carries f_fstypename (then configure takes the BSD branch) or when the macro is replaced by a recipe-level source selection. It enables every `__linux__` branch of fontconfig, so each new fontconfig version must be re-checked.
